marta_peopleops: Drafting a compact 7-day sprint + 30/60/90 sketch for managers running new-hire onboarding. Paste below — please :eyes: or add edits.

marta_peopleops: ```
Day 0 (pre-boarding): accounts provisioned, welcome email + hardware, share team org chart, quick TL;DR of priorities
Day 1: intro + access check, team stand, role expectations, 1:1 scheduled, buddy intro
Day 2: product walkthrough, shadow session, small first task assigned
Day 3: infra & permissions walkthrough, write-first-pr-change, docs reading list
Day 4: cross-team synces, customer context, OKR mapping
Day 5: demo first task, 30-day goals check, feedback loop
Week 2-4: ramp tasks, weekly 1:1 + manager check-ins, initial eval prompts
30/60/90 (manager guidance): 30d outcomes, 60d ownership, 90d cross-team impact
Who to ask: IT (access), DevEx (SDKs), Security (data handling), Buddy (day-to-day)
Manager checklist: daily 1:1 first week, clear 30-day milestone, introduce to stakeholders
``` 

ethan_hiringmgr: This is excellent. Quick add: include infra quota request + who to ping for GPUs.

jamie_it: @ethan_hiringmgr @marta_peopleops added infra snippet below. Also see IT playbook link: https://intra.redwood/it/playbook

- GPU quota: open ticket -> Priority: onboarding -> attach hire start date
- Machine setup: mac/linux image, VPN, MFA enrolled
```

```
